_comment: Baseline do bang lenh: python scripts/check-openapi-schema-budget.py (tu packages/core/backend). Cong nay CHAN THOAI LUI, khong chan no san. Ha baseline xuong khi ban sua so loi.
_measured_by: manage.py spectacular, sau khi them @extend_schema cho 32 file view (batch1/2/3) + 5 file o commit truoc
_counting_rule: Gate so sanh TONG (errors) va UNIQUE (errors_unique) rieng biet. 'errors' la so dong loi spectacular phat ra (mot operation co the nhieu dong); 'errors_unique' la so ten loi khac nhau. Do bang lenh nay nen cam hai con so phai cung he so sanh.
_why_not_zero: 35 unique operation con bi spectacular bo qua ('unable to guess serializer'). KHONG con view GenericAPIView trong danh sach nay: 34/35 la FUNCTION-BASED view (login_view, logout_view, register_view, register_tenant_view, verify_email_view, refresh_token_view, password_reset_request_view, password_reset_confirm_view, password_change_view, resend_email_verification_view, partner_issue_pat, partner_rotate_pat, partner_revoke_pat, partner_revoke_session, personal_keys_*, dnse_* api, broker_* api, retail_* api, StripeWebhookView, admin_ops_gone) — can khai bao bang @extend_schema tren FUNCTION chu khong phai tren method, va nam trong vung auth/nghiem vuc nhay cam; 1 con la DataIngestAdminViewSet (ViewSet). StripeWebhookView nam trong vung Stripe dang DONG BANG nen khong sua.
_delta_this_commit: Gate do bang chinh lenh: errors 752 -> 154 (-598), errors_unique 139 -> 35. Xoa het loi cua 32 file view trong 3 batch. Con 35 unique thi da het view GenericAPIView co the sua tu dong; phan con lai can khai bao function-view va vung Stripe/VNPay dang DONG BANG.
_kept_warnings_note: Warnings khong doi so voi truoc khi them decorator: 4x UnifiedAlertSerializer, 2x TenantLifecycleEventSerializer, 1x IngestJobSerializer, 1x SessionFactsSerializer, 3x StockManagementTrackedSymbol*.
